headline: Congress takes a breather with pro forma sessions as both chambers stay dark until Thursday!

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate met in pro forma session on Monday, October 19, convening at 9:00 a.m. and adjourning just thirty seconds later at 9:00:31 a.m. No legislative business was conducted. The chamber will remain in recess until reconvening Thursday morning.

house.lastSessionSummary: The House met in session for just two minutes on Monday, October 19, convening at 10:00 a.m. and adjourning at 10:02 a.m. Representative Goldman (TX) was appointed to act as Speaker pro tempore for the day. Fifteen public bills and five resolutions were introduced, but no votes were taken.
